An '''Ancient Mandalorian helm''' was a [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] left behind by a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Krath Holy Crusade]]. About [[3627 BBY|370 years later]], it was considered a valuable historical artifact, being recovered and taken to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
